questions.prompt: What does «У меня много работы сегодня.» mean?
options: I have a lot of work today.
I have a bit of work today.
How much work do I have today?
questions.explain: «Много» plus the genitive «работы» means a large amount of work.

questions.prompt: In «У меня мало денег.», what case is «денег» in after «мало»?
questions.explain: «Мало» governs the genitive, so «денег» (money) is genitive.

questions.prompt: How would you say "He works very much / a lot"?
questions.explain: «Он очень много работает.» attaches «много» to the verb «работает», intensified by «очень».

questions.prompt: Choose the word that completes «У меня ___ денег.» to mean "I have little money":
questions.explain: «Мало» expresses scarcity, giving "I have little money."

questions.prompt: What does «Сколько стоит этот билет?» ask?
options: How much does this ticket cost?
questions.explain: «Сколько» with «стоит» is the standard way to ask how much something costs.

questions.prompt: Which sentence means "There are many people in the city"?
questions.explain: «В городе много людей.» uses «много» plus genitive plural «людей» for many people.

questions.prompt: «Дай мне немного воды.» means:
options: Give me a lot of water.
questions.explain: «Немного» plus genitive «воды» requests a small, modest amount of water.

questions.prompt: In «У нас было много времени.», why is «было» neuter?
options: Because the quantity expression behaves as neuter
questions.explain: The «много времени» quantity expression behaves as a neuter subject, so the past «было» is neuter.

questions.prompt: How do you ask "How old are you?" using a quantity word?
questions.explain: «Сколько тебе лет?» (literally how many years are to you) is the fixed way to ask someone's age.

questions.prompt: What does «У него много друзей в школе.» say in English?
options: He has few friends at school.
How many friends does he have at school?
He has a couple of friends at school.
He has many friends at school.
questions.explain: «Много друзей» with genitive plural «друзей» states he has a large number of friends.

questions.prompt: «Он мало спит ночью.» tells us that he:
options: sleeps a bit better at night
questions.explain: «Мало» attached to the verb «спит» means he sleeps little.

questions.prompt: Which word pairs with «сколько» in the correlative «Бери ___, сколько нужно.» (take as much as needed)?
questions.explain: «Столько» pairs with «сколько» as a correlative meaning take as much as is needed.

questions.prompt: How would you say "I read many books"?
questions.explain: «Я читаю много книг.» uses «много» plus genitive plural «книг» for a large quantity of books.

questions.prompt: In «Я немного устал сегодня.», what does «немного» do?
options: Softens the state to "a little tired"
questions.explain: Here «немного» works as a degree word, lessening «устал» to "a little tired."

questions.prompt: «В этом году мало снега.» means:
options: There is a lot of snow this year.
How much snow is there this year?
There is so much snow this year.
There is little snow this year.
questions.explain: «Мало» plus genitive singular «снега» says there is little snow.

questions.prompt: Pick the sentence that means "Why do you spend so much money?"
questions.explain: «Почему ты тратишь столько денег?» uses «столько» plus genitive «денег» with a tone of disapproval at the amount.

questions.prompt: What does «Это слишком много для меня.» mean?
options: This is too much for me.
This is too little for me.
This is just enough for me.
How much is this for me?
questions.explain: Standing alone with «слишком», «много» means "too much"; no genitive noun is needed when the amount is clear.

questions.prompt: Which sentence contrasts with «В классе сегодня мало учеников.» by stating there are MANY pupils?
questions.explain: Replacing «мало» (few) with «много» (many) flips the count to "many pupils."

questions.prompt: How do you say "Add a little salt to the soup"?
questions.explain: «Добавь немного соли в суп.» uses «немного» plus genitive «соли» for a small portion of salt.

questions.prompt: In «Дай мне столько же, пожалуйста.», what does «столько же» mean?
questions.explain: «Столько же», with «же» marking equivalence, requests the same amount as something already mentioned.
